context: UI components like TextRender need to store Strings and dart:ui Paragraphs, which cannot be flatly packed into Float32List or ByteData like other ECS components.
avoided_paths: Building Paragraphs every frame, which causes massive GC allocations and violates performance constraints.
Attempting to map strings into flat integer arrays, which adds excessive complexity.
decisions: Allow standard Dart classes for UI components requiring object references.
Enforce caching of render objects (Paragraph, Offset) directly on the component.
Use a dirty flag to conditionally rebuild objects only when component properties (text, color, size, etc.) change, preserving zero allocations during static rendering frames.
